name: FPS Optimizer
description: FPS cap with min/max/target, adaptive savings, experimental Force FPS and Extreme mode, and a fake FPS display.

max-fps.name: Max FPS
max-fps.description: Frame cap. 0, or anything at or above 100000, means no cap. Stored as a signed 32-bit value, so the largest allowed number is 2147483647.

min-fps.name: Min FPS
min-fps.description: The floor the adaptive optimizer defends. If FPS drops below it, more savings switch on. 0 means no floor (the target is used instead).

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: What the adaptive optimizer aims for when Min FPS is 0.

adaptive.name: Adaptive optimization
adaptive.description: Switch savings on when FPS drops below the floor, and ease them off again when there is headroom.

disable-particles.name: Disable particles
disable-particles.description: Skip drawing all particle effects. Large gain on integrated GPUs in effect-heavy levels.

disable-trails.name: Disable trails
disable-trails.description: Skip drawing motion-streak trails (icon trails). Wave trails are not covered yet.

force-fps.name: Force FPS (experimental)
force-fps.description: Applies the strongest savings immediately and keeps them on. Shows 5 warnings before it turns on. Always switches itself off again when the game starts.

extreme-mode.name: Extreme mode (experimental)
extreme-mode.description: Only does anything while Force FPS is on. Removes the FPS cap and applies every implemented saving at once.

jump-improvement.name: Jump improvement (placeholder)
jump-improvement.description: Reserved for an input-responsiveness feature. It does nothing yet.

show-overlay.name: Show FPS overlay
show-overlay.description: Shows FPS, frame time and the current savings level in levels.

fake-fps.name: Fake FPS display
fake-fps.description: Shows custom text instead of the real number. Display only: it never changes your real FPS or what the optimizer uses.

fake-fps-text.name: Fake FPS text
fake-fps-text.description: What to show. Presets: eps0, omega, knux, inf, 9001, NaN. Any other text is shown as typed. Game fonts lack some Greek symbols, so the presets use plain letters.

fake-fps-tag.name: Add "(fake)" tag
fake-fps-tag.description: Appends a small (fake) tag so screenshots and recordings are not misleading.
